title: MENA equity issuance slumps 71% in H1 2026 as GCC issuers reassess plans amid war
summary: A senior executive at ENBD Capital said several companies are looking at ECM trades after summer
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, equity and equity-related issuances totalled just $2.1bln during the first six months of 2026 Image used for illustrative purpose Image courtesy: Getty Images

A senior executive at ENBD Capital said several companies are looking at ECM trades after summer

Against the backdrop of the Iran war, MENA equity and equity-related issuance activity fell sharply, plunging 71% compared with the same period a year earlier, as intermittent attacks against the GCC countries began in late March.
